entries.value: Leona
This... it's one of my favorite things.
Thank you. You just made my whole day.
Oh, I actually needed this.
I'll put it to good use. Thanks!
Oh, thank you. I'll take it.
Ah... I appreciate the thought, but...
Could you bring something else next time?
Um, this is a little awkward...
This is my least favorite thing...
Strawberries! Oh my goodness, my absolute favorite.
These could keep me going all night. Thank you so much!
Wood! I was just about to build another shelf.
Just what I needed. Thanks!
Seeds... I'm really not good at growing things.
You'd do a much better job planting these.
We've already talked plenty today.
Come by again tomorrow!
You've already given me two gifts this week.
I'd feel bad taking so many. Let's wait until next week!
Hi! Working in the fields again today?
I've been keeping busy making things here.
The thing I made yesterday started creaking strangely.
Every time I fix one part, something else goes wrong. Is that normal?
The weather is lovely today.
On days like this, there's nothing better than being outside.
Oh, you're the newcomer.
You'll settle in little by little. There's no rush.
Come to think of it, there's something I've been wondering.
Do you... like strawberries?
Yes, I love them!
I knew it! Me too.
I've never met a bad person who likes strawberries.
No, not really...
Oh... I guess we don't have that in common.
Well, everyone has different tastes.
Your farm's really starting to look good, isn't it?
I've been sneaking a look whenever I pass by.
Let me know if you ever need a hand.
Would it be okay if I helped?
Thanks, I'd appreciate it!
Great! Call me anytime.
I'm stronger than I look, you know.
I'm fine. I can manage on my own.
You're so capable.
Still, let me know if things get tough.
Somehow, talking to you always cheers me up.
Thanks for stopping by again today!
I'm glad I came to this village.
Because I got to meet someone like you.
Here's to more good days together!
The First Morning
A small farm, far from the city I left behind.
Today, I begin a new life of my own here.
The First Morning
Plant seeds and water them, and crops will grow.
I heard people live in Dove Village beyond the hill. I should visit.
Here's a movement example. I'll take a short walk!
Just write the commands in order like this. When the scene ends, I return to my usual spot.
